第9章 黑子的篮球九
之后的几场比赛帝光都赢得顺风顺水，而原田也迅速出名，其他球队也都开始补订针对他的应对方案。这对于原田来说，是好事也是坏事。
说是好事是因为这说明原田的实力值得肯定。说是坏事，便是由于原田的身高的确不占优势。一旦对方让几个人同时拦他，他就没有机会出手了。
不过这对于帝光整体来说，是不会有哪怕是一丁点儿的影响的。如果对方很强，那么经验不足的原田不会上场；再者，弱队的话，奇迹的时代上去一个他们就顶不住了。
所以，对于原田的出名，赤司一点儿也不着急，反而颇有种乐见其成的样子。
毫无悬念的，帝光以小组第一的名次出线，进入了决赛。
而到目前为止只上场过寥寥几次的帝光首发————奇迹的时代，也开始进入备战状态了。
他们有赢的绝对实力，但是，他们同样不会轻敌。
无论什么时候，都要确保自己能够取得胜利，要万无一失。
对于这种想法，原田是欣赏的。也许别人羡慕他们是天才，生下来就拥有了值得骄傲的资本。但是原田看的很清楚，在和他们在一起的日子里，没有一个人迟到早退，没有一个人对于自己现有的实力自得意满。他们一直是努力的，不论哪一个人。
对于他们先天的资本，他们骄傲的同时一样珍惜，该练习的时候认认真真。
他们五个人，都是天才与努力的结合体。
这样的他们无法得到胜利，谁还能够夺过头筹？
四进三帝光赢得不简单却也不艰难。
之后就是仅剩的三支球队比出个一二三来了官场特种兵。赤司带领众部员制订了详细的作战计划，而在桃井五月的帮助下，获得优胜应当是理所当然的事情。
并没有再做什么高强度的练习，赤司只是吩咐大家要好好休息，就让大家回家了。
而赤司接到家里的电话，匆匆和原田说了声自己今天不能和他一起走了就匆忙离去。
在一边离得很近的黄濑凑过来，“赤司今天不和你一起哦，那我们一块儿走吧~”
不觉得有什么不妥的原田点点头，黄濑朝众人摆摆手，便和原田并肩回家。
而黄濑也的确是个善于调节气氛的人，一路上也没有冷场，两人说说笑笑的倒是都很愉快。

原田原来看动漫的时候就很喜欢黄濑，在这个人的身边时从来不会寂寞，那双暖黄色的眼眸很温柔，也很温暖。
而正当气氛无比融洽的时候，有一阵子没有听到的机械声音突如其来的响起，破坏了这淡淡的温馨。
“玩家触发随机任务，给黄濑写一封情书，并当面送给他。任务完成获得瞬移的能力，失败玩家将得到必须完成任务三件。任务时限：三天。”
原田想了想，时限三天…与叶匡的比赛，就在后天。
把任务的最后期限定在比赛当天…没关系，可以在比赛之后给就好了。
敏感的黄濑停下脚步，关切的低头看他，“没事吧，你的脸色不太好。”
原田摇了摇头，笑笑，“只是想到点事情而已。”
愉快的氛围变得不太自然，黄濑欲言又止，终是什么也没说。
原田回到家，疲惫的将自己扔到床上。埋在被子里的脸被遮的严严实实，决定先睡一觉再费脑细胞想情书该怎么写，那种东西真是完全没写过。
第二天原田还没有想出来该怎么写。
到了决战之日。
原田这天最后一个才到，因为他拖到昨天才终于动笔开始写情书，他想着要怎么才能写着符合系统对于情书的要求，又可以让那看上去像是一个玩笑。真是头疼啊。
于是他昨晚很晚才搞定的，累的不行，今天就起晚了。
上场之前。
部员们在更衣室里换着队服，原田没有注意到外套口袋里的信封不小心掉了出来。身边的部员弯腰捡起来，见原田没有发现，好奇的拆开来看。
随即，这个人愣了愣，揶揄的笑着大力拍了拍原田的肩。
“哟，我们的一年生也有喜欢的人了？”
原田不解的皱了皱眉，“你在说什么？”
那人摇了摇手上的信，“如果不是，你怎么会在参加这么重要的比赛时还随身带着给人家的情书？”
原田一把抢过来，不自然的回答，“谁说这是情书。”

“当然了，明明白白的写着‘我喜欢你’嘛。”
原田无奈的笑，“不要误会啦，这只是个玩笑而已啦。”
虽然那人依旧一脸不信的表情，原田也懒得再解释，反正也不重要啦。
时间到了，赤司给大家做了做简单的煽动就带领大家上场了民国之钢铁狂潮。
黄濑皱着眉，好像有些不舒服，原田注意到了，但没有机会询问，只能先放在一边。
一开始大家还没有注意，但上场没几分钟，赤司就狠狠地皱起眉头，黄濑今天是怎么回事？
不仅没有发挥出练习时的水准，而且球到了手里也很茫然，甚至频频被对手抢走。
这该死的到底是怎么回事？
赤司叫了暂停，黄濑一下来就劈头盖脸的训斥，黄濑垂着头听着，没有回嘴，任由赤司数落。
而发现黄濑大概是生病了的原田见他不说话想帮他解释一下，开口道。“征十郎，黄濑他好像有点发烧……”
还没有说完，黄濑猛地抬起头打断了他，向赤司保证道，“我会注意的，请再给我一次机会。”
赤司往黄濑身上扫了几眼，淡淡的道，“希望你不会再让我失望。”
黄濑抿紧了唇。哨声再次响起后，看的出来黄濑的确是想努力找到感觉，而他的表现也确实要好了一些。但是，谁也没想到会发生那样的事。
叶匡的队长今年就要毕业，这次是他在国中时期最后一次全国大赛，他拼了命也想获得优胜。而叶匡现在已经是前三，只要胜了帝光，那么他相信最后一场的胜利就是他的囊中之物了。本来对于奇迹的时代，即使他想要做什么小动作也会被他们避开，但是太幸运了……
他阴险的看着黄濑，今天这个人明显不在状态，平常不可能成功的偷袭在今天看来却是不成问题的，现在的黄濑，简直是漏洞百出……
他假装防守的接近了黄濑，然后装作是不小心绊了一下，借力狠狠地踩上黄濑的脚踝……
“唔！”黄濑摔在地上，痛苦的捂住自己的脚踝，冷汗瞬间补满了整张脸。
“黄濑！”一直在场边不放心的盯着黄濑的原田发现了叶匡的动作，可是已经来不及了。
在众人还没有反应过来发生了什么时，原田已经反应很快的冲了过去。
小心翼翼的蹲在他身边，原田的声音因为担心有些不稳。“你怎么样……”

黄濑抬头，苍白的脸上努力的挤出一丝微笑，“还好，不用担心。”
原田没有去听黄濑的逞强，而是仔细的观察了一下黄濑的伤势。
他是医生，自然可以看得出黄濑的伤势有多么严重。看着这个只有十六岁的男孩即使受了这么严重的伤也依旧保持着他的温柔，原田觉得自己有点为这个少年心疼。他早就不是孩子了，但即使是活的比他要长，他自认如果受伤的是自己，也很难做到在这种时候还能坚持微笑，不让身边的人担心。
这是个令人心疼的孩子，也是个温柔到让人不自觉想要守护的孩子。
这样的人，这么会有人能够忍心伤害他呢。送去医院之后看能不能治好他，如果不能，自己也一定会想办法，让这个男孩再次站到球场上，打他喜欢的篮球。
其他人已经叫了救护车，护着黄濑一起上了车后，示意赤司他们不用太过担心，有自己一起，不会有事的。
临上车前原田看了一眼那个叶匡的队长，这个人即使是最后赢得了胜利，也一样让人觉得可悲。
content_en:
Chapter 9 Kuroko’s Basketball Nine
Teiko won the next few games smoothly, and Harada quickly became famous, and other teams began to make up their plans to deal with him. This is both a good thing and a bad thing for Harada.
It's a good thing because it shows that Harada's strength deserves recognition. It's a bad thing because Harada's height is really not an advantage. Once the opponent lets several people block him at the same time, he has no chance to take action.
However, this will not have even the slightest impact on Diguang as a whole. If the opponent is strong, then the inexperienced Harada will not play; moreover, if the team is weak, they will not be able to withstand one in the Era of Miracles.
Therefore, Akashi is not anxious at all about Harada becoming famous, but rather seems to be happy to see it happen.
Without any suspense, Teikou ranked first in the group and entered the finals.
And Teikou, who has only played a few games in the starting lineup so far, has also begun to prepare for the Era of Miracles.
They have the absolute strength to win, but they will not underestimate the enemy.
No matter when, you must ensure that you can win and be foolproof.
Harada appreciates this idea. Maybe others envy them that they are geniuses and have something to be proud of since they were born. But Harada saw clearly that during the days with them, no one arrived late or left early, and no one was complacent about his current strength. They have always worked hard, no matter who they are.
They are proud of their innate capital and cherish it at the same time. They take it seriously when it is time to practice.
The five of them are a combination of genius and hard work.
If they can't win like this, who can take the lead?
Winning the Four Advancements and Three Emperors' Light is not easy but it is not difficult either.
After that, the only three remaining teams competed and came to the official special forces. Akashi led the members to formulate a detailed combat plan, and with the help of Momoi Satsuki, winning should be a matter of course.
There was no more high-intensity training. Akashi just told everyone to have a good rest and sent everyone home.
When Akashi received a call from home, he hurriedly told Harada that he could not leave with him today and left in a hurry.
Kise, who was very close to the side, came over and said, "Akaashi is not with you today, so let's go together~"
Harada nodded as he didn't think there was anything wrong. Kise waved his hands to everyone and went home side by side with Harada.
And Kise is indeed a person who is good at adjusting the atmosphere. There was no silence along the way, and the two of them talked and laughed happily.
Harada originally liked Kise when he was watching anime. He would never feel lonely when he was around this person. Those warm yellow eyes were very gentle and warm.
Just when the atmosphere was extremely harmonious, a mechanical sound that had not been heard for a while suddenly sounded, destroying the faint warmth.
"The player triggers a random mission, writes a love letter to Kise, and gives it to him in person. After completing the mission, you will gain the ability to teleport. If you fail, the player will receive three items that must be completed. Mission time limit: three days."
Harada thought for a while, and the time limit was three days... The match with Ye Kuang would be the day after tomorrow.
Set the deadline for the task on the day of the game...it doesn't matter, just give it after the game.
The sensitive Kise stopped and looked down at him with concern, "Are you okay? You don't look good."
Harada shook his head and smiled, "I just thought of something."
The pleasant atmosphere became unnatural, and Kise hesitated to speak, but finally said nothing.
Harada returned home and threw himself on the bed tiredly. With her face buried in the quilt and covered tightly, she decided to get some sleep first and then use her brain cells to think about how to write a love letter. I had never written anything like that before.
The next day, Harada still hadn’t figured out what to do.Write.
The day of decisive battle has arrived.
Harada was the last one to arrive that day, because he put off writing a love letter until yesterday. He was thinking about how to write a love letter that met the system's requirements and make it look like a joke. What a headache.
So he finished it very late last night. He was so tired that he got up late today.
Before taking the field.
The members were changing into uniforms in the locker room, and Harada didn't notice that the envelope accidentally fell out of his coat pocket. The member next to him bent down and picked it up. Seeing that Harada didn't notice it, he opened it curiously and took a look.
Immediately, the man was stunned, smiled teasingly, and patted Harada's shoulder vigorously.
"Hey, our first-year students also have someone they like?"
Harada frowned in confusion, "What are you talking about?"
The man shook the letter in his hand and said, "If not, why would you still carry a love letter to others when you participate in such an important competition?"
Harada grabbed it and replied unnaturally, "Who said it was a love letter?"
"Of course, it clearly says 'I like you'."
Harada smiled helplessly, "Don't get me wrong, this is just a joke."
Although the man still had an expression of disbelief, Harada didn't bother to explain anymore, it wasn't important anyway.
When the time came, Akashi gave everyone a simple incitement and led everyone to participate in the Steel Frenzy of the Republic of China.
Kise frowned, as if he felt uncomfortable. Harada noticed it, but had no chance to ask, so he could only put it aside.
Everyone didn't pay attention at first, but within a few minutes of playing, Akashi frowned fiercely. What happened to Kise today?
Not only did he not perform to the same level as in practice, but he also felt confused when the ball came into his hands, and was even frequently snatched away by his opponents.
What the hell is going on?
Akashi called a timeout, and Kise immediately scolded him. Kise listened with his head lowered, without replying, and let Akashi scold him.
Harada, who realized that Kise was probably sick, wanted to explain to him when he didn't speak, so he spoke. "Seijuro, Kise seems to have a fever..."
Before he finished speaking, Kise suddenly raised his head and interrupted him, promising Akaashi, "I will pay attention, please give me another chance."
Akashi glanced at Kise a few times and said calmly, "I hope you won't let me down again."
Kise pursed his lips. After the whistle sounded again, it was obvious that Kise was really trying to find the feeling, and his performance was indeed better. However, no one expected that would happen.
Ye Kuang's captain will graduate this year. This is his last national competition in junior high school. He worked hard to win. And Ye Kuang is now in the top three. As long as he defeats Di Guang, he believes that the final victory will be in his pocket. Originally, in the Age of Miracles, even if he wanted to do something small, he would be avoided by them, but he was so lucky...
He looked at Kise insidiously. This person was clearly out of shape today. Sneak attacks that were usually impossible to succeed seemed to be no problem today. Kise now is simply full of loopholes...
He pretended to be defensive and approached Kise, then pretended that he accidentally tripped, and used his strength to step hard on Kise's ankle...
"Ugh!" Kise fell to the ground, covering his ankle in pain, and cold sweat instantly covered his entire face.
"Kise!" Harada, who had been staring at Kise worriedly from the sidelines, noticed Ye Kuang's movements, but it was already too late.
Before anyone could realize what happened, Harada reacted quickly and rushed over.
Harada carefully knelt down next to him, Harada's voice was a little unsteady due to worry. "How are you..."
Kise raised his head and tried his best to squeeze out a smile on his pale face, "It's okay, don't worry."
Harada did not listen to Kise's show off, but carefully observed Kise'sInjury.
He was a doctor, so he could naturally see how serious Kise's injuries were. Seeing that this sixteen-year-old boy still maintained his gentleness even after suffering such serious injuries, Harada felt a little sorry for this boy. He is no longer a child, but even if he lives longer than him, he thinks that if he is the one who is injured, it will be difficult to keep smiling at such a time and not worry the people around him.
This is a heart-wrenching child, and a child so gentle that people unconsciously want to protect him.
How could anyone have the heart to hurt such a person? After sending him to the hospital, he will see if he can be cured. If not, he will definitely find a way to let the boy stand on the court again and play the basketball he loves.
The others had already called an ambulance, and after escorting Kise into the car, they told Akashi and the others not to worry too much. As long as they were with them, nothing would happen.
Before getting into the car, Harada glanced at Ye Kuang's captain. Even if this man won the victory in the end, he would still feel pathetic.
